title: Count Triplets with Zero Sum
statement:
Given an array of integers, count the number of unique triplets (i, j, k) with i < j < k such that A[i] + A[j] + A[k] = 0.

Two triplets are the same if they contain the same multiset of values.
inputFormat:
The first line contains N.
The second line contains N space-separated integers.
outputFormat: A single integer: the number of unique triplets summing to zero.

examples.explanation: Sorted: -4,-1,-1,0,1,2. Unique triplets summing to 0: (-1,-1,2), (-1,0,1). With duplicates counted: 3 total triplet index-combos.
